description: Maintain and extend seven internal systems for a retail group—HRIS, ERP, e-learning, asset management, and a supplier portal. Built a document-archive module with multi-tier approval and HRIS-sourced signatures from scratch, hardened the HRIS mobile API against SQL injection and concurrent clock-in races, and shipped signed-URL video streaming for the LMS.

Shipped e-commerce and company sites end to end for direct clients, including a Laravel + Vue storefront with a full Xendit checkout and webhook-based order status, scoping requirements and triaging fixes myself.
